name: Wikidata SPARQL
label: Wikidata SPARQL
description: Wikidata SPARQL official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: sparql_query. Docs: https://query.wikidata.org/. WDQS official SPARQL. Wikidata CC0. WMF UA policy — identifying UA required (WDQS UA exception ended 2026-02-18). 60s deadline. Heavy queries are killed. Scholarly split is query-scholarly.wikidata.org. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Wikidata SPARQL request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"sparql_query"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: sparql_query. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'sparql_query'.

schema.label: format
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `format` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `query` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: sparql_query.

configurationParameters.label: User Agent
configurationParameters.description: Identifying User-Agent with contact. OfficialApiNode currently sends StudioQuack-NodeLibrary/1.0.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 60. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
